test_scope: paired title + thumbnail concepts; description is prepared per concept but only one can be active during a native title/thumbnail experiment

concepts.question: If pumice is falling and roofs are weakening, is shelter safer than flight?
concepts.answer: Residents faced different dangers while stones accumulated; some left while routes remained open, others sheltered, and some were killed in collapses.
concepts.title: Pompeii’s Choice: Flee the Falling Stones or Shelter?
concepts.thumbnail_situation: A Pompeian doorway frames two risks at once: a street choked with falling pumice outside and roof beams straining over a dark interior. No bodies or injuries.
concepts.image_difference: The doorway makes the human decision the subject; the image does not depict the later ash surge or an excavation.

concepts.question: Was Pompeii buried by lava, or did another volcanic sequence destroy it?
concepts.answer: The film distinguishes falling pumice, earthquakes, collapsing structures and later pyroclastic flows from the familiar lava-flood image.
concepts.title: Pompeii Wasn’t Buried by Lava. What Actually Destroyed It?
concepts.thumbnail_situation: A low, wide view of a dark ash-and-gas surge sweeping toward Roman rooftops beneath Vesuvius. No glowing lava, no doorway choice, no excavation.
concepts.image_difference: The visible moving ash cloud and volcano explain the physical mechanism; the image does not center a person’s shelter decision or daily life.

concepts.question: What can Pompeii’s buried streets still reveal about the people who lived there?
concepts.answer: The film shows bakeries, workshops, homes, objects and excavations, while explaining what the traces and casts cannot establish about every person.
concepts.title: Pompeii’s Ordinary Lives, Preserved Under Ash
concepts.thumbnail_situation: A sunlit Roman bakery in daily use, with loaves, oven and painted walls; the restrained drawn Nuviko traveler appears small at the edge, observing the scene. Vesuvius is calm and distant.
concepts.image_difference: The warm, ordinary bakery scene is about the life preserved, not the eruption’s immediate danger or the later pyroclastic surge.

visual_qc.method: Visual inspection at full size and local 320x180 preview

findings.A: Communicates falling pumice outside versus roofed shelter; roof strain is not unmistakable at phone preview.
findings.B: Fails assigned concept: reads as a tall eruption column/cloud, not a ground-hugging pyroclastic flow reaching the city.
findings.C: Correct restrained drawn-traveler style and no obvious anatomy defect, but traveler is about 40% of image height versus <=15% specified; dark backpack from channel profile is absent.

visual_qc.decision: Revise B and C before user approval; no uploaded card/device surface was available.
